title: Depth-zero circuits are literals
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $m$ variables — a tree whose leaves are literals and whose internal nodes are AND or OR gates applied to lists of subcircuits — and suppose its depth is $0$. Then $c$ is a single leaf: there exists a literal $l$ such that $c$ consists of that literal alone.
hypotheses_covered: c is a Boolean circuit on m variables
replaced:
If a circuit $c$ has depth $0$, then $c$ is a single literal: there exists a literal
$l$ with $c = \mathrm{Circuit.lit}\,l$.
